TEXT:
Akagi stood there with bloodshot eyes and heavy 
breathing.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Huff... huff...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What are you doing, Akagi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: O-Onii-chan? Why are you here?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
Ahh, Akagi-san's big brother. What's the matter? Are 
you here to join the-

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: ...[font_size=33]Huuuuh!??[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Eek!

That bloodlust filled glare is just taking things too 
far. Look, Makabe is about to cry.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [font_size=18]U-Um... Why are you glaring so intently at me...?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Grrrr!!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Eeeek!

He's too far gone... This beast can't understand 
human language anymore.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
*sigh* This is why I told you to end your lover's 
quarrel outside...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-It's not my fault!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Yeah. This has nothing to do with him.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Geez, why did you come here, Onii-chan? If you 
came to interfere with club activities, then go 
home!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: I'm not here to cause trouble...

Giving the crowded room a cursory glance, Akagi 
continued.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Everyone... Thank you for taking care of my sister all 
this time. I'm Sena's older brother, Kouhei Akagi.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Y-Yeah. We should be thanking you. Your sister is 
always helping us. I'm the club president, Miura.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Hello.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I'm Gokou.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: It's a pleasure.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [font_size=18]I-I'm Makabe.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [font_size=33]HUUUUHHHH!???[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Eeek!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hey, cut it out! If you don't have any reason to be 
here, then leave!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
So if I have a reason, I can stay? Then this is 
observational study!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
I'm here because I'm interested in the Game 
Research Club! I love games so much; I always 
carry one around, see?!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Isn't this... the game I gave you recently?! Why did 
you bring it to school?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
I carry most things my dear Sena-chan gives me, 
or stash them in my safe① I've saved your 
Valentine's chocolate from every year there①

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Wha... I-I'm never giving you chocolates ever again!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
No please, Sena-chan! That kind of mental 
punishment won't make me happy, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I didn't say it to please you! You're too creepy!

Hey now, it took so much effort just to get on good 
terms, but sparks are already flying between you 
two.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
...Hmm. You've actually played this soccer game, 
how interesting.
...This time, someone unexpected spoke up.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
There were some horrible stories about how this 
game was rushed to meet the deadline...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Players sinking into the ground, the ball veering in 
random directions, the clock going backward, even 
save data corruption...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
The [font_size=28]legendary game[/font_size] that sends the 
player to hell!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
I'm not one to brag, but I managed to 
raise all the players to [font_size=28]max stats.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[font_size=33]What!?[/font_size] You spent that much time on the mother of 
all shitty soccer games? What madness drove you to 
do that!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
The moment I made the player's name "The Angel 
Sena-chan", my victory was guaranteed.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Don't go raising me up in a soccer game! Did you 
name all the players after me!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
But of course~ Sena-chan on defense, Sena-chan on 
offense, starting member Sena-chan, and Sena-chan 
on reserve! There is no better formation than this!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
And the team's coach is none other than me...! This is 
truly Akagi Japan...!

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: I see, I see... Hey listen, I have a proposition to make.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
If it's alright with you, can you lend your talents to 
our game development team?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=33]Huh!?? What are you saying, 
President?![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
But don't you see? He has good taste in games. If 
he's interested in game creation, it would be a 
waste for him just to look.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
He struck a nerve with your preference for shitty 
games, didn't he...

SPEAKER: SPK_BOTH
TEXT: [font_size=30]W[/font_size][font_size=33]H[/font_size][font_size=25]A[/font_size][font_size=33]A[/font_size][font_size=30]!??[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Eeeeek!

This time they both yelled in unison. The president 
and Akagi make for a good combination.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Let's get back to the topic at hand. Will you assist 
us in the production of our game?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I am completely against this! I definitely don't want 
him staring at me throughout club activities!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
I am in complete agreement! Being able to stare at 
Sena-chan while working on club activities, is this 
heaven on Earth?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Ah geez, Onii-chan... you're the absolute worst...!

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Calm down. Don't argue, you two. You both have 
your reasons, but let's look at the problem at hand 
here.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Our club is severely lacking in members now. Ain't 
that right, Kousaka?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, yeah... That's for certain.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
According to your schedule, there's a possibility 
that we'll miss the deadline for the festival with this 
amount of people, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
We can't use the club members who don't even 
show up, so why don't we make use of that guy 
here?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I'm agains--

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I approve.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?

Kuroneko interrupted Sena and raised her hand. 
Lots of things I didn't expect are happening on this 
very day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Lately, it feels that we are short-handed. Akagi-san 
has been handling more work than usual, but 
there's no guarantee she can keep this up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
And besides that, our work is at a standstill now 
thanks to this dispute. We don't have the time to 
waste.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Either a debugger staring at the screen till he vomits 
blood, or a masseur for his cute sister, we ought to give 
him a suitable task. Don't you think so?

Kuroneko looked my way. Well... both the president 
and Kuroneko are right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Y-Yeah... that's right. Our bickering over Akagi is just 
a waste of precious time. Since our club president 
said to include him, let's go with that for now.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Okay, then it's settled? I'll come in here as I please 
then!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Whaaa-!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [font_size=17]...Eh...[/font_size]

Makabe... You're screwed one way or another this 
time. H-Hang in there, okay?
With that out of the way, work began...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Akagi-san. Is this CG okay with you?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Hmm... Can you increase the amount of juices? 
There should be so much that it's collecting on his 
collarbone.

...The two girls are having an unbelievable 
conversation. I'm so engrossed with the screen over 
here that I can't make a remark though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...How about this?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Ummm, I think something similar to an oily texture 
would look captivating... Get it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's hard to understand the nuance.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Sorry to be a bother, but can the President and 
Makabe try this out?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [font_size=28]No way!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
...Hey, if Makabe's the model for the game, why'd 
you call me too?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Isn't it obvious?! It won't work if we don't have the 
side that's shooting and the side that's shot on, for 
the President's Bukka--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=33]Stop whatever you're saying, right 
now![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Hey Kousaka, my little Sena's knows a thing or two, 
huh? She's so cool, almost like a pro.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
What kind of pro?! It's cause you pampered her so 
much that she turned out this way!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Hey Sena-chan, if you need some more materials, 
Onii-chan can pitch in and help, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Shut up, Onii-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Kay.

...Such a noble, good-looking man reduced to nothing 
with just a single phrase from his sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Ah, but... Kousaka-senpai is here too, so you can use 
his face for bukka--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=33]Heeeey! Give me a break!![/font_size]

Watching us arguing back and forth, Kuroneko 
sighed and interjected.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Akagi-san... You...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
I've been wondering for a while now but... Even in 
this game, do you not plan on holding back on your 
precious love of BL?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: O-Of course... Of course I do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
In fact, with your brother's presence, it's obvious 
that your delusions have been getting increasingly 
worse.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Onii-chan has nothing to do with this!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Hey hey, don't quarrel, you two...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Hey you bastard, acting like you're trying to 
mediate, but you're just trying to sneak a feel of 
Sena-chan!? Huuuuhhhh!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Eeeeek!

Makabe scowled at by Akagi caused him to curl 
himself up again. He's having a real bad day...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
That's enough, Onii-chan! You said you would help, 
but you aren't even doing anything! You're just in 
the way!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
We're short on time, so go help out with something, 
got it?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: S-Sorry Sena-chan. Of course I'll help, yeah?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Ummmm...? Hey Kousaka, how do you do this 
"double click" thing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Wow, you're more useless than I am...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Hey, if you can't help out, wanna face me in that 
soccer game?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Ah, sounds good!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Sound good? Get real!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Why the heck are you even trying to play, 
President!

...Utter chaos. I mean, it was chaotic before, but 
Akagi just made it more chaotic...

At this rate, we won't make it in time for the school 
festival.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
For the time being, stop playing at once, President. 
What are you even planning, inviting Akagi along 
with this charade?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Yeah! You're the club's president for goodness 
sake!

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Geez, I was just helping the new member break 
the ice. Even I of all people do consider the needs 
of others.

Well, it is true that he does things in his own way 
for the club.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
But now's not the time for that. He joined us to 
alleviate our work and to keep to the schedule, but 
playing games will ruin everything.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Hahaha, You really hit where it hurts. Let's call it 
quits with the game then.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: *sigh* ...Thank goodness.

The President kept the game console while Akagi 
just looked on enviously while contributing nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: I wanted to show him my Akagi Japan save data...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You don't have to show him something so 
embarrassing! Good grief, I've told you that if you 
can't help then get out!
The usually calm Sena finally lost her temper.

This is bad, we're already behind schedule to begin 
with, but if this keeps up...
